title: Gouda and Spinach Stuffed Pork Chops
description: Delicious stuffed and breaded pork chops made with six ingredients - thick-cut pork chops, smoked gouda, fresh spinach, horseradish mustard, panko crumbs, and Creole-style seasoning.
ingredients: 0.5 pound fresh spinach, rinsed and torn into bite-size pieces
0.5 teaspoon Creole seasoning, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Lay each pork chop flat on a cutting board. Use a sharp knife held parallel to the board to cut a deep pocket into each chop, leaving three sides intact. Fill each pocket with spinach, then cheese.
Place panko crumbs in a shallow dish. Spread a thin layer of horseradish over each chop, then roll in crumbs to coat. Arrange chops in the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with Creole seasoning.
Bake in the preheated oven until brown and crispy, about 45 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into pork should read at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).

video.description: Elevate your pork chop dinner into the truly sublime with these delicious stuffed chops! After slicing a pocket into each chop, stuff with fresh spinach and smoked Gouda cheese. Coat lightly with horseradish, then roll in crispy panko crumbs and finish with Creole seasoning. Bake until browned, crispy and temptingly melty inside.  With prep so quick and simple and cook time out of hand, what are you waiting for? A great dish for hectic weekdays or impressing pork chop-loving guests!
